dedupe_keys.name: auckland council flood plains and flood sensitive areas

description: Auckland Council publishes the Auckland flood plains, the area inundated by runoff in a storm with a 1 per cent or greater annual probability assuming maximum probable development and future climate change, mapped from hydraulic modelling, and the flood sensitive areas, land adjacent to the 100-year floodplain within 0.5 m of the predicted flood level. Coverage: the Auckland region; the flood plains are updated at catchment scale (last modified on 2026-09-25) and the flood sensitive areas were last modified on 2024-09-18, with a source note dated 23 May 2013. Format and access: CSV, shapefile, GeoJSON and KML downloads plus ArcGIS REST feature services, without registration from the Auckland Council open data hub. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Auckland Council Catchments and Hydrology data set disclaimer (no open licence named on the layer pages); cost: free. Caveats: the layers come from catchment-level models of varying age and uncertainty, and the council disclaimer says they do not replace site-specific assessment; the licence is a use disclaimer, not an open licence, so reuse terms should be checked before redistribution. Simulation uses: flood-hazard layers for exposure analysis of buildings and infrastructure, planning constraints for adaptation studies, and validation of urban flood models. Related catalogue records: other layers and datasets of the same portal in this catalogue are contextual companions.
